description: This file defines the `LangFuseHandler` class which provides static methods for managing and retrieving `LangFuseLogger` instances based on dynamic or static credentials. It handles caching of loggers for requests, creating new loggers when needed, and fetching configuration for logging based on request parameters.

classes.name: LangFuseHandler
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for handling LangFuse loggers, including retrieving, creating, and caching loggers based on request parameters and credentials.

methods.name: LangFuseLogger get_langfuse_logger_for_request( standard_callback_dynamic_params: StandardCallbackDynamicParams, in_memory_dynamic_logger_cache: DynamicLoggingCache, globalLangfuseLogger: Optional[LangFuseLogger] = None, )
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a `LangFuseLogger` for a given request, based on dynamic credentials or falling back to a global logger.

methods.name: LangFuseLogger _return_global_langfuse_logger( globalLangfuseLogger: Optional[LangFuseLogger], in_memory_dynamic_logger_cache: DynamicLoggingCache, )
methods.description: Returns the global `LangFuseLogger`, either from parameter or cache.

methods.name: LangFuseLogger _create_langfuse_logger_from_credentials( credentials: Dict, in_memory_dynamic_logger_cache: DynamicLoggingCache, )
methods.description: Creates a new `LangFuseLogger` from provided credentials and caches it.

methods.name: LangfuseLoggingConfig get_dynamic_langfuse_logging_config( standard_callback_dynamic_params: StandardCallbackDynamicParams, globalLangfuseLogger: Optional[LangFuseLogger] = None, )
methods.description: Generates the logging configuration based on dynamic request parameters or defaults.

methods.name: bool _dynamic_langfuse_credentials_are_passed( standard_callback_dynamic_params: StandardCallbackDynamicParams, )
methods.description: Checks if dynamic credentials are supplied in the request parameters.
